case.summary: The customer reported a $128.33 online purchase they did not make, which was linked to transaction 3583227 on card C08106-K1. Evidence shows the amount is far outside the card's typical history and the device profile was new for this account, both pointing to fraud. The investigation concluded the transaction was fraudulent and the case was closed as fraud. The card was blocked and a case was created for record-keeping. No further action is required beyond monitoring the account for any additional suspicious activity.
